description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance for the Workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom & Pepper Manufacturing Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers based on the Cost of Living Index Number, issued under Section 20(2)(b) of the Wages Boards Ordinance. It pertains to the implementation of a regulatory framework (the Ordinance) and sets compliance requirements for wage payments in a specific trade, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter.
